title: Agent-editable conformance tests
description: spec/agent-editable/tests.json: one test per requirement of the agent-editable spec, with its level. A checker loads this file instead of hard-coding requirement ids. See spec/agent-editable/levels.md.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

version.description: The version of the agent-editable spec these tests belong to.

spec.description: The spec file the tests come from, relative to the spec/ folder.

tests.description: One entry per requirement, in the order of the spec.

id.description: The requirement id from the spec. Stable: never reused for a different meaning.

level.description: The lowest level that includes this requirement. Levels are cumulative.

keyword.description: MUST: the level is reached only when the test passes. SHOULD: a failure is a warning and never lowers the level.

scope.description: What the checker reads: the source folder, the output folder, or both.

how.description: automated: a checker decides it with no person. review: a person decides it by following check; a checker reports it as not run.

network.description: Present when part of the test needs network access. A checker runs that part only when its network option is on, and reports it as not run otherwise.

description.description: The requirement's text, from the spec.

check.description: How a checker or a person decides the requirement, from the spec.
